rationale: Builds on the recurrent-tail baseline with a cheap, compile-stable output-path change: add a learned 2-way boundary-conditioned vocab bias keyed by whether the previous token is a tokenizer boundary. This directly targets final byte-weighted eval behavior with minimal size cost, preserves the existing quant-aware/export path, and also hardens the optimizer split to ignore non-floating state tensors introduced by the lookup table.
title: Boundary-Conditioned Logit Bias
